title: How long he stayed at Milton's with Julia
summary: Smith argues the Milton's stay was nearer seven years; Lovett admits his memory is vague.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Okay. After the inauguration where were you, at Milton's.
I see. And how long were you at Milton's with Julia?
Well, I guess about -- let's see, maybe about three or four years, not too long, it wasn't too long, or five years. Not over five.

Are you sure? It had to have been more than five if you were there -- if you were with Julia Lee when you went with Basie in '42, you were with Julia Lee in '45 when the two of you went to the inauguration --
-- of President Truman, then you came back. I would think it would be closer to seven years you were together at Milton's.
It could have been. I've forgotten, I'll tell you the truth. It's been so long.
So much has been written about that, you know.

That's why I can -- you know, I'm remembering what I read, however what I read might not be true either, and you're the man that was there. But if your memory, you know, isn't that good, why we'll do the best we can, all right?
